analysis_notes.existing_model_leakage_audit: The repository's default sentinel/ml.py train() script loads 100% of data/csic_2010/normalTrafficTraining.txt into model.fit(). If an evaluation were to test against normalTrafficTraining.txt directly, there would be 100% train/test data leakage on normal traffic. For this evaluation, we strictly partitioned normal traffic into an 80% train split (22,400 samples) and 20% held-out test split (5,600 samples) with zero overlap.
analysis_notes.why_hybrid_wins: Rules alone have very low FPR (0.00%) but miss attacks that do not match known regex patterns (lower recall). ML alone detects 98%+ of anomalies but has a higher false positive rate (10.97%) on varied normal traffic. The Hybrid architecture balances both: ML alone is never permitted to block (only alerts), while high-severity rules block immediately and low-severity rules require ML confirmation, achieving high precision and high recall.
